author: implementation-agent

findings.summary: Exact dictionary proxy route duplicates the existing v2 catch-all proxy behavior.
findings.consequence: The route adds a second place to preserve the same apiBase-to-backend forwarding rule for /api/v2/dictionary/articles, so future proxy policy changes can drift between the exact route and the catch-all route without adding a distinct behavior boundary.
findings.evidence: Line 5 proxies the constant path "dictionary/articles" with apiBase. The sibling catch-all server/routes/api/v2/[...path].ts gets the decoded path and calls proxyBackendRequest(event, apiBase, path), which forwards the same /api/v2/dictionary/articles request to the same upstream path. The relevant unit and e2e tests assert the same forwarding behavior through this exact route, but I found no behavior in the exact route that differs from the catch-all proxy dependency.
findings.recommendation: Delete server/routes/api/v2/dictionary/articles.get.ts and let server/routes/api/v2/[...path].ts handle /api/v2/dictionary/articles, or keep the exact route only if it enforces a dictionary-specific policy not present in the shared catch-all proxy.
